author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I stay away from building "useful engineering" agentic skills, since I know this domain is well taken care of by other capable engineers in the company

I build all those "useless" skills that save you 5 mins here, 10 minutes there on the mundane tedious tasks 

I also build some "crazy" skills that no sane person would think of how to use AI that way.  My motto is: if you burn enough tokens, miracles will happen
